description: OWOX Data Marts connects ChatGPT/Codex to your company's governed analytics layer. Data Analysts define trusted data marts — metrics, dimensions, and join logic — on top of your own warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Athena). From ChatGPT/Codex you can discover the right data mart with natural-language search, inspect its fields, query governed data and get answers with server-side totals — computed from analyst-defined metrics and joins, never guessed from raw tables — and manage recurring report run schedules. Your data stays in your warehouse; OWOX connects to it but never retains it.
